claims.claim: Mechanism direction improved across three same-simulator generated datasets, but full gate passed for only one.
claims.boundary: Not independent external systems; no formal significance claim.

claims.claim: Equal-update persistent-calibration baseline challenge gave a mixed trade-off.
At the complete-fit time cap, wider GRU has lower recorded error in all paired mechanism and short-horizon comparisons.
claims.boundary: Same simulator and locked recipes; wider capacity and more updates within time cap.

claims.claim: Candidate has lower long-horizon error in 7/9 pairs with wider GRU and 9/9 with graph GRU.
claims.boundary: Not broad accuracy superiority, speed benefit or a redefinition of the failed full gate.

claims.claim: The six methods had the same 600-second complete-fit cap; their realized times and update counts differ.
claims.boundary: Not equal capacity, equal updates, inference latency or equal total historical research cost.

claims.claim: Smaller persistent state might matter for a separately specified deployment setting.
claims.boundary: No measured deployment advantage is asserted.

claims.claim: No general quality-cost advantage established; some task/resource-dependent trade-offs remain useful research questions.
claims.boundary: Neither universal superiority nor universal impossibility.
